content: Firefox/Gecko/Opera/IE (Bugzilla #385622): when niqqud diacritics are missing from the active font, they are not substituted from a fallback font — they simply vanish (silent failure). DejaVu Sans historically had broken niqqud rendering. Many fonts lack OpenType mark/mkmk positioning, causing shva/other points to overlap or misalign under their base letter. Unicode NFC/NFD normalization can reorder combining marks and disrupt niqqud stacking order.
